_doc: Change-proposal branches for the PR simulation. 'implements' branches take their proposal commit(s) from the disposition record of the named sheet comment (so the proposal is itself attributable). 'seeded_broken' branches are fixtures that MUST fail the pre-merge gate and never merge; 'expect_exit' records the compile exit status the fixture is designed around (checked, so a branch that 'fails' only because the compiler crashed is distinguished from one that exits 0 and is caught by the verdict rule).
